summary: Iteration 31 - Relatório de Movimentação de Materiais (ledger) + Auditoria de materiais. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed covering ledger structure/coherence/chronological ordering, add-manual→avulso event, PATCH→edit event with old→new (no-op does NOT log, 404 nonexistent, 400 no valid field), partial/total requisitions→requisicao events, resend→reenvio general, fulfillment→separado/entregue (skips qty=0), warehouse response→resposta_almox, confirm-receipt→recebimento, returns→devolucao by item, CSV import→import general + per-item import events with imported_at, PDF endpoint (200, application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment with 'movimentacao_materiais_', contains expected phrases via pypdf), XLSX endpoint (Resumo/Eventos/Obra sheets, exact event headers, TOTAIS row), empty project ledger (items=[]/summary zero), 404 invalid project. Frontend: /relatorios renders material-ledger-panel; project search+select works; selecting LEDGER-TEST-01 loads summary with 8 KPIs; items table renders 2 rows; clicking row expands ledger-item-events-{id} showing EventRow items (ledger-event-*); ledger-item-filter filters correctly; ledger-toggle-general reveals ledger-general-events; PDF and XLSX buttons trigger network calls to /materials/ledger/pdf and /xlsx both returning 200. Regression: legacy report cards (Programação, Carteira, Produção, Faturamento, Equipes, Indisponibilidade, Improdutividade, Retorno) still visible on /relatorios.

issues: KPI value text uses same color as label in some tiles (e.g., 'Saldo a req.' with #A855F7 on dark bg is legible but low contrast on 0 value; overall OK). Minor only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 5900+ lines - would benefit from splitting materials/requisitions/audit into modules.
_log_material_event uses secrets.token_urlsafe(6) for event id (~8 chars, unique enough per project scope).
material_ledger.build_material_ledger correctly resolves resolve() by id first then name; well-guarded against missing material references. Chronological sort by ISO string is safe.

PATCH /projects/{id}/materials/{item_id}: 'notes' field is in allowed set but does not appear in FIELD_LABELS for ledger event detail (falls back to raw key 'notes' → detail shows 'notes: old → new' if edited). Consider adding 'notes' label mapping in material_ledger.FIELD_LABELS.
MaterialLedgerPanel.jsx: no explicit loading/error state for PDF/XLSX besides toast + button-disabled - acceptable UX.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/cleanup TEST_LEDGER_<timestamp> projects and TEST_LEDGER_EMPTY_<timestamp>. Frontend used existing LEDGER-TEST-01 (6aaa9e62447dd09661943ce6) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration31.py covers ledger + audit end-to-end. Total backend suite iterations 25-31 all passing. Frontend MaterialLedgerPanel confirmed working on preview URL. All data-testids expected in review present. For future ledger enhancements, note that _log_material_event stores events in project.material_events and ledger derives requisicao/separado/entregue/resposta_almox/recebimento/devolucao dynamically from data (not audit log) - two separate sources reconciled in build_material_ledger.
